data.name: Battle Nations
data.detailed_description:
Battle Nations is back! Build your empire and lead your armies to victory! Choose from traditional troops and vehicles or unleash exotic forces like mammoths, velociraptors, sandworms, and futuristic plasma units!

War has engulfed the continent of Ateria, and only your leadership can end the rebel threat. Construct and manage a thriving city, gather critical resources, and assemble your unstoppable army. Engage in epic battles across diverse terrains using various unique units. Build and customize your thriving city, optimizing resource management and defense. Unite with memorable heroes and charismatic misfits, each with their own compelling stories. Experience a richly developed wartime narrative filled with humor, drama, and surprises. Compete and collaborate with players around the globe through guilds and multiplayer events. Strategically unlock powerful mercenaries, tanks, and one-of-a-kind special forces. Challenge yourself with tactical combat scenarios and PvP battles to prove your supremacy.

Join the ranks, Commander—your empire awaits!

reviews.review:
Wanted to post a positive review for the game because recently the game has been review bombed by people upset about a balancing nerf.

To explain to those who have not played Battle Nations before: An event called a "Boss Strike" happened, that ended up being significantly harder for the average player base than the developers had anticipated. In order to remedy this, as the developers didn't have enough time to rework the event, they introduced a unit that was better than any unit in the game at the time, The Nomad. This came with the information that it would be nerfed, and people can buy as many as they want, but do not expect it to stay the same.

(Quick Aside: This warning of the incoming nerf was repeated at least 3 times, and was extremely common knowledge amongst anyone in the discord. I do feel for any Chinese players who did not receive this knowledge, as I'm not 100% sure it was relayed in the in-game announcement.)

Okay, lets fast forward a month or two, and we had our level increased, yay! This allowed the Nomad to go from the best unit in the game, to something even more powerful it was absurd. Earlier before we had our level increased, there was maybe an argument for 1-2 other units, but now it was so broken it didn't make sense anymore. Again, we had been warned that it would be nerfed, and there was no "Boss Strikes" while it was in this stage. 

Anyway, the next Boss Strike has rolled around, and as a surprise to almost nobody, the Nomad was nerfed. And it was pretty heavily nerfed, in comparison to its former glory. Now, is it still a top 5 unit in the game? Yup. Anyone reviewing that it was "gutted" is probably someone who bought 50x of them, and is just really pissed off.

Now the reason I am writing this is because you will have probably read reviews like this: "The developers just released an OP unit, got everyone to buy it, then nerfed it right before the event! They are so evil and I hate them!!!!" 

Hopefully now you can read the actual recounting of the events and not be swayed by the opinions of the organized and disgruntled few. That being said, I do have my own issues with the game, but being review bombed for something like what I described above is silly. If you want to know why they choose to review bomb, I would suggest you look up "STS2 Review Bombing for Doormaker", as unfortunately Chinese players don't have very good outlets to Western Developers.


Anyway, once this fiasco passes, which I imagine will be after this Boss Strike concludes, I will probably edit this review to be of my complete thoughts of the game in that mode, until then have a good day!
